title: Quaint Crunchy Slovakian Noodle Bowl
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring clear honey and crunchy noodles, served in a lacquerware bowl, this ovo-vegetarian friendly meal is a nostalgic delight, with a perfect balance of briny and sweet flavors.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
Meanwhile, heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add the crumbled tempeh.
Cook the tempeh for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until it is golden brown and crispy.
Add the grated carrots to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in the soy sauce, clear honey, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Drain the cooked noodles and add them to the skillet, stirring to combine with the tempeh and carrot mixture.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a lacquerware bowl and top with chopped green onions.
